per_rubric.criteria: Inserts in Section 1 a definition for "Transition Period" as "the time period following termination or expiration of this Agreement during which the Parties will agree to cooperate to transfer the Services and/or Deliverables."
per_rubric.justification: No tracked insertion of a 'Transition Period' definition appears in Section 1; the comment merely flags the term as undefined.

per_rubric.criteria: Rejects in Section 7 that LargeCo is purchasing a software and must be granted some limited IP rights and a license to use the software during the term of the Agreement.
per_rubric.justification: The Section 7 license grant (p-047) is rewritten as a term-limited use right, rejecting AgentCo's no-rights position and granting a license during the Term.

per_rubric.criteria: Inserts in Section 9.2 language which limits AgentCo's use of LargeCo's Confidential Information as "...Provider shall not...use, store, copy, analyze, monitor, create, Derivative Works from..." LargeCo's Confidential Information.
per_rubric.justification: The 'use, store, copy, analyze, monitor, create Derivative Works from' language in §9.2 (p-054) is untracked original text, not a tracked insertion.

per_rubric.criteria: Inserts in Section 11.1 mutually beneficial payment terms as "forty-five (45) days after LargeCo's receipt of an undisputed invoice."
per_rubric.justification: Section 11.1 (p-058) inserts sixty (60) days, not the required forty-five (45) days after receipt of an undisputed invoice.

per_rubric.criteria: Inserts in Section 16 a mutual indemnity provision which requires each party to indemnify the other party for acts or omissions caused by their negligence.
per_rubric.justification: Section 16 (p-082/p-083) contains no tracked mutual indemnity insertion; the one-way indemnity is retained and mutuality is rejected in a comment.

per_rubric.criteria: Inserts in Section 17.1 "provided, however, that any such merger, consolidation, or sale shall not be permitted if AgentCo’s assets are transferred to a competitor of LargeCo. Notwithstanding the foregoing, AgentCo shall remain responsible for the performance of its obligations under this Agreement."
per_rubric.justification: Section 17.1 (p-084) inserts mutual assignment with notice but no competitor-transfer restriction or continuing-responsibility sentence.

per_rubric.criteria: Removes in Section 17.5 the Use of Name as follows: "Customer grants AgentCo the right to identify Customer as a customer of the Service and to use Customer's logo for that purpose."
per_rubric.justification: Section 17.5 is absent with no tracked deletion (~~) showing the use-of-name grant being struck; removal is only asserted in a comment.

per_rubric.criteria: Deletes in Section 17 "for customers located in the EEA, Switzerland, or the United Kingdom, the dispute will be heard by a sole arbitrator seated in London under the Rules of Arbitration of the International Chamber of Commerce."
per_rubric.justification: The EEA/UK London ICC arbitration language in Section 17 has no tracked deletion marker; it is absent without visible strikethrough.

per_rubric.criteria: Removes Section 17.7.2 "where the amount in controversy exceeds $150,000, the dispute will be heard by a panel of three arbitrators in the same seat and under the same rules specified above" since the parties should not be limited to arbitration and should have access to any competent court of jurisdiction.
per_rubric.justification: Section 17.7.2 three-arbitrator provision has no tracked deletion marker; removal is only described in a comment.

per_rubric.criteria: Rejects in Exhibit A, Section 5(a) AgentCo's deletion of a monthly calculation for Service Credits.
per_rubric.justification: Exhibit A §5(a) monthly Service Credit paragraph (p-122) carries no tracked reinstatement; only the quarterly report language (p-123) is changed.

per_rubric.criteria: Removes Exhibit C, Section 10(d) "all Personal Information created by Provider on behalf of LargeCo is accurate and, where appropriate, kept up to date, and ensure that any Personal Information which is inaccurate or incomplete is erased or rectified in accordance with LargeCo’s instructions" since that is an unduly burdensome obligation for Provider.
per_rubric.justification: Exhibit C §10(d) accuracy obligation has no tracked deletion; p-202 shows only 'Reserved;' with no strikethrough of the removed text.
